additional_info.subject: RE: ID0399580-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / PN 170001120] One outlet is OoO CRM:01811000574
additional_info.body:
Hello Yunus,
We have analyzed the logs and observed that the IMD BC2 error is intermittently appearing and disappearing, which is likely the cause of the issue you are experiencing. The logs indicate an error related to "no new data from IMD received within 5s via Modbus," suggesting there may be some loose connections that we need to investigate.
It is less likely that the IMD itself is faulty, as there is no error in the error flag, meaning the issue is not continuous. However, we recommend carrying a spare IMD in case a replacement is needed during troubleshooting.
MLFB N0.
8EM5903-0AA00-0AA1 -BC1, -BC2, -BC3, -BC4 Insulation Monitoring Device
Additionally, we have reviewed the charging sessions and found that some sessions failed due to authentication issues, while others encountered a temporary V2G error.
If the issue persists or if you need any assistance during site intervention, please don’t hesitate to reach out. We are here to support you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
